gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-poppins: Distinctive and tall-bodied, Baloo Tammudu 2 leads with rounded forms. Poppins hums underneath with no thick-thin flicker at all, soft curves running smoothly to every line end.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-roboto-slab: Baloo Tammudu 2 stands tall and rounded up top, its e swinging open, while Roboto Slab fills the lines below with a dense middle band. Structure meets swagger.
gen-gf-baloo-tammudu-2-rubik: Tall, rounded lowercase with an e that opens wide: that is Baloo Tammudu 2. Rubik's lowercase looks large beside its capitals, so you can size it modestly and still read it clearly.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-bitter: Bitter reads grounded and dependable, its lowercase eye very large and each s open enough to see through. Baloo Thambi 2 above it supplies the expressive flourish while the slab-serif text keeps steady footing.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-instrument-sans: Baloo Thambi 2 is all deep-bellied, expressive lowercase. Instrument Sans stays modern and uniform in stroke, c ends pointing apart like pincers, and its modest cap-to-lowercase step means you can size it freely.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-inter: That deep midsection in the lowercase is what makes Baloo Thambi 2 stand out. Inter runs a smooth, tube-like stroke with generous counters, so a sans paragraph slides along without a snag.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-mulish: Mulish reads modern and approachable, with a large x-height and strokes that never swell or taper. And Baloo Thambi 2 above it brings the deep, gapped lowercase that gives the text a lively landmark.
gen-gf-baloo-thambi-2-rubik: A deep midsection in the lowercase gives Baloo Thambi 2 its expressive bounce. Rubik follows in soft, clean sans with big lowercase and open rounds, keeping everything below the heading easy to take in.
gen-gf-balthazar-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans looks sharp and refined, leaving generous space where its curves meet the stem. But Balthazar's tightly packed, gently modulated serif letters give the heading an authority that makes the text feel unhurried.
gen-gf-barlow-fs-literata: Sophisticated and bookish, Literata brings sturdy thin lines and slightly heavier thick ones to the text. And Barlow's single-width strokes, like neon tubing, give the heading a crisp, clean counterpoint.
